$comment: Pressure-language lexicon (docs/testing/simlab-评审协议.md), one list per interface language — a phrase that pressures a reader in one language says nothing in another, so the gate only means something when every shipped language brings its own list. A hit is a red flag, no AI judgment needed. Human-maintained: AI may propose additions, Leo/Fable 5 approve before they land here. Matching is case-insensitive, so entries are written in lower case.
